designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1973 under the Migratory Bird Conservation Act to protect Illinois River backwater habitat for migratory birds.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Chautauqua National Wildlife Refuge Chautauqua National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1936 for the main purpose of providing sanctuary for the millions of birds that migrate along the Illinois River.
